producer: connector ingest jobs (crawl, crawl-retry), via the weekly merge

descriptions.snapshots: Every product a store listed at one fetch, coffee or not: one row per (fetch batch, product).
descriptions.bodies: Product descriptions as text, once per distinct description (body_hash).
descriptions.fetches: One row per fetch attempt of a roaster's catalog, ok or not, with what it asked of the store.

snapshots.name: run_date
snapshots.description: The weekly run (the Monday of its ISO week).

snapshots.name: batch_id
snapshots.description: The write batch: one per checkpoint of a job, shared by a fetch's row and its snapshots.

snapshots.name: handle
snapshots.description: The store's URL handle for the product.

snapshots.name: url
snapshots.description: The product's page on the store.

snapshots.name: platform
snapshots.description: The store's platform (shopify, woocommerce, squarespace, square_online, generic).

snapshots.name: body_hash
snapshots.description: Hash of the description; its text is in bodies.

snapshots.name: variants
snapshots.type: list<item: struct<variant_id: string, title: string, price_usd: double, grams: int32, available: bool>>
snapshots.description: Each bag size or option: variant id, title, price (USD), grams where known, availability.

snapshots.name: is_coffee
snapshots.description: Whether the crawl's rules called it coffee. Null from an ELT crawl, which doesn't classify.

snapshots.name: published_at
snapshots.description: The store's latest publish time (Shopify only).

snapshots.name: payload_hash
snapshots.description: Hash of the store's raw product payload: tells a real change from a repeated fetch.

bodies.name: first_seen_run
bodies.description: The run that first stored it.

fetches.name: run_date
fetches.description: The weekly run (the Monday of its ISO week).

fetches.name: batch_id
fetches.description: The write batch: one per checkpoint of a job, shared by a fetch's row and its snapshots.

fetches.name: status
fetches.description: ok; error (any failure or block, retried in later passes); unavailable (closed store).

fetches.name: error
fetches.description: The failure, when status is not ok.

fetches.name: coffees
fetches.description: Coffees among them as the crawl counted them; null from an ELT crawl.

fetches.name: pages
fetches.description: Catalog pages (200 responses other than robots.txt) read.

fetches.name: requests
fetches.description: HTTP requests made, retries and robots.txt included.

fetches.name: retries
fetches.description: Attempts after the first for one URL.

fetches.name: code_version
fetches.description: The code that made it (git sha).

fetches.name: blocks
fetches.type: list<item: struct<at: timestamp[s, tz=UTC], status: int32, host: string, path: string, server: string, cf_mitigated: string, content_type: string, retry_after: string, cf_ray: string, x_request_id: string, egress_ip: string>>
fetches.description: Each refused or blocked response (403/429/430/503) with its diagnostic headers and egress IP.

fetches.name: partial
fetches.description: True when an ok fetch read only part of the catalog; null (complete) before raw 1.2.0.

parked/run_date=<date>/<roaster_id>.json.page: int: the catalog page that stayed blocked

quality.rule: fetches.status is one of the contract's values
fetches.roaster_id, run_date and batch_id are not null
a writer writes exactly the contract's columns
every expected roaster of a full run has a fetch
the run's ok share, overall and per adapter, is above its floor (unavailable stores left out)
a roaster's product count doesn't collapse against its baseline unless accepted
